fusions.name: Stoop From Above
fusions.desc: Dives hooves-first onto a target at or below 25% health up to 7 tiles away, dealing 28 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Wingbeat Gust
fusions.desc: Beats your wings in a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage with a 20% chance to leave each enemy [Slowed] for 3 seconds. For 2 seconds after, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Skyward Bound
fusions.desc: Leaps up to 6 tiles on spread wings, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after landing.

fusions.name: Hollow Bones

riders.text: and a beat of the wings takes you clear
and the gallop costs you less

fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 5%, and from gold your stamina recovers 10% faster.
